description: The first farmhouse upgrade is 10,000g and 450 Wood, the second is 65,000g and 100 Hardwood, and the third is 100,000g. In 1.6 the second payment replaced 50,000g and 150 Hardwood. Each upgrade takes three days. After the second upgrade, a renovation is a separate order and finishes immediately.
